## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Reviewprogress ofWorks andworkpermit control
- Review training requirements
- Reviewworkproceduresandmethodstatements
- Review Incidents and near misses and any lessons learned arising from Program Partners shall ensure that all major decisions and actions proposed by the meetings are effectively documented and communicated for implementation.
- Pre-Work/Toolbox Meeting(s) shall be held prior to the relevant work activity being carried out.

## 2.4.1.6. Consultation:

- Positive consultation and engagement with the workforce can lead to sustained and improved health and safety performance. It recognizes that in addition to meeting regulatory obligations, effective consultation and engagement is a fundamental mechanism for achieving high standards and good H&S performance. Each Program Partner is required to make appropriate arrangements associated with worker consultation and engagement initiatives on each of their projects based on:
- Compliance with statutory requirements
- Construction personnel understanding that they are permitted to stop work if they feel at risk
- Advising personnel of the mechanismsforreporting health and safety issueswithin theProgram Partners team
- Taking no negative, critical action against any worker for raising a health and safety issue
- Ensuring that all personnel are addressed in a civil manner by all other personnel
- Include in every ‘toolbox talk’ an opportunity for personncl to ask questions and make comments
- Operating a consultation mechanism, and bringing this to the attention of all personnel in the Program Partners controlled area
- Respecting appointment arrangements established among the personnel, specifically the appointment of safety representatives.

## 2.4.2. Systems 2.4.2.1.Health and Safety Management System (HSMS)

The health, safety and welfare of all personnel, the general public and the avoidance of damage to thc environment or other assets (Beyond Zero) are of paramount importance to FMAAR Misr. Prime considcration shall bc givcn by Program Partners to ensure that all operations are conducted in such a manner as to eliminate the risks to as low as reasonably practicable (ALARP) to persons, property and the environment.
